errors.permissionDenied: You don't have permission to do that.

accessDenied.title: You don't have access to this page.
accessDenied.explanation: Your role doesn't include this permission. If you need it, ask an administrator.

update.available: A new version of the app is available.
update.activatedElsewhere: The app has been updated in another tab. Reload this tab when you're ready.
update.pageExplanation: This page is from an older version of the app. Reload to pick up the new one — anything you have already saved is safe.

offline.youAreOffline: You're offline — this will refresh when you reconnect.
offline.pageExplanation: This page needs a connection to load. Check your network and try again — anything already loaded is still available.

sync.offlineWithCount_one: You're offline — 1 change waiting to send
sync.offlineWithCount_other: You're offline — {{count}} changes waiting to send
sync.readFailedDetail: We can't read your pending changes right now. Your work may still be unsent — keep this tab open and try again.
sync.blockedExplanation: Changes are sent in the order you made them. The first item needs your decision before the rest can be sent.

status.conflict: This was changed somewhere else while it waited. Decide what to do with your version.
status.dead: This couldn't be sent after several tries.

discardConfirm.title: Discard this change?
discardConfirm.body: It will not be sent, and this can't be undone.

sync.actionFailed: Could not update your pending changes. Please try again.

notifications.syncConflict: An offline change couldn't be saved — the record changed on the server. Check the sync panel.
notifications.syncDead: An offline change failed repeatedly and won't be retried. Check the sync panel.
